title: Technical Assistance Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Network TAC2 Engineer to provide advanced technical support for enterprise networking infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting complex network issues, configuring and hardening Cisco devices, and ensuring high availability across the network environment, working in a 24×7 shift-based support model.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 technical support for network-related incidents escalated from TAC1, ensuring timely diagnosis and resolution.
* Configure,
  **troubleshoot**
  , and maintain Cisco routers and switches in production environments.
* Design and implement high-availability solutions using HSRP and other failover mechanisms to minimize downtime.
* Configure and manage AAA (Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting) for secure network access control.
* Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize BGP routing for WAN/ISP connectivity and multi-site environments.
* Plan and execute Cisco IOS upgrades, including compatibility checks, rollback planning, and change management coordination.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring or critical network incidents and provide permanent fixes.
* Maintain accurate documentation of network configurations, topology diagrams, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* Collaborate with TAC1, NOC, and engineering teams to resolve escalations and improve network stability.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs for incident response and resolution.
* Work in a 24×7 rotational shift environment, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays as per roster.

**Key Skills Required**

**Technical Skills**

**Routing Protocol**

Static, Dynamic (OSPF, BGP)

**Redundancy Protocol**

HSRP, VRRP, GLBP

**Router configuration.**

Hand-on experience on Cisco must. Fortinet, Huawei would be add-on.

**IOS Upgradation**

Planning and executing Cisco IOS upgrades with minimal downtime

**Others**

VLAN, AAA, IPSEC, Netflow, SNMP, TCP/IP, Subnetting

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Electronics, or a related field. (B. Tech Any Specialization BCA MCA, BSc IT.
* Minimum 2-4 years of experience in network support/TAC roles, preferably in an ISP, telecom, or large enterprise environment.
* **Cisco certifications preferred:**
  CCNP (Routing & Switching / Enterprise), CCNA as minimum.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, IPSEC, Failover and general networking fundamentals.
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (Everest/Zabbix/SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, etc.).
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

**Work Details**

* Shift: 24×7 Rotational (Rotational offs)
* Location: Manesar
* Diversity Considered

Notice Period Minimum 30 Days Immediate joinee

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a dedicated IT Support Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing technical support and assistance to our clients and internal teams. This role requires a strong understanding of IT systems, hardware, and software, as well as excellent troubleshooting skills. As an IT Support Engineer, you will be the first point of contact for technical issues and will work to resolve them efficiently and effectively. Key Responsibilities: - Provide technical support to users via phone, email, and in-person. - Troubleshoot hardware and software issues, ensuring timely resolution. - Assist in system administration tasks, including user account management and system updates. - Maintain and manage IT inventory, including hardware and software assets. - Document and track support requests and resolutions in the ticketing system. - Collaborate with other IT team members to improve support processes and enhance user experience. - Stay updated with the latest technology trends and best practices in IT support. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of IT support principles and practices. - Proficiency in troubleshooting hardware and software issues. - Experience with system administration tasks. - Familiarity with various operating systems and software applications. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. If you are passionate about technology and enjoy helping others, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to grow your career in IT support.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Technical Lead - Technical Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and provide L2 support for Value Added Services (VAS) platforms, primarily SMSC and USSD.
* Manage production incidents, perform impact assessment, lead incident bridge calls, and ensure timely resolution within defined SLAs.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and drive preventive and corrective actions.
* Perform system administration and troubleshooting on Linux servers.
* Develop and execute basic to intermediate automation scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to improve operational efficiency.
* Execute basic database administration and troubleshooting activities on MySQL and Oracle databases.
* Monitor application health, system performance, and service availability while proactively identifying potential risks.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Customer Support teams for issue resolution, deployments, and change management activities.
* Support software upgrades, patch deployments, and production releases while ensuring minimal business impact.
* Maintain operational documentation, incident reports, and knowledge base articles.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, operational governance, and customer SLAs.
* Demonstrate a basic understanding of GSM network elements and their interaction with telecom applications.
* Possess working knowledge of Operating System Virtualization concepts to support virtualized environments.


**Required Skills**
**Technical Skills**
* VAS Platforms: SMSC, USSD
* Operating Systems: Linux
* Incident Management: Incident handling, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Production support
* Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell (Basic to Intermediate)
* Databases: MySQL, Oracle (Basic to Intermediate)
* Telecom: Basic knowledge of GSM architecture and network elements
* Virtualization: Basic understanding of OS virtualization technologies
